name: Door
description: A door that opens for the player inside a level (the level change is an exit behind it). Applies to every behaviour-7 type. MSR 'Doors that open when a squadron is dead'.

fields.name: keyLock
fields.description: 0 open; 1 locked until unlocked by a squadron or switch; n >= 2 needs item n - 2

fields.name: doorId
fields.description: squadrons with this door id lock it (0 = none); only the first door with an id gets locked, so give each locked door its own id

fields.name: otherLocks
fields.description: bits 0-3: hero not allowed; 0x80 needs Floyd; 0x40 needs game flag 0
